front.title: Extensions to the YANG Data Model for L3VPN Service Delivery

abstract.t:
[RFC8299] defines a YANG data model for L3VPN service delivery. The base L3VPN Service Model (L3SM) has limitations regarding dynamic service features. In addition, emerging technologies including SRv6 and quantum security bring new service capabilities available to customers, which are not natively supported by L3SM. This document defines a set of extensions to address the limitations of L3SM.
These augmentations are designed to be backward-compatible and do not obsolete [RFC8299].
